1. (1) Perintah ini boleh dinamakan Perintah Hak Cipta
(Entiti yang Diberi Kuasa) 2022.

 (2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 30 Jun 2022.

Entiti yang diberi kuasa

2. Badan atau institusi yang tidak mencari keuntungan yang dinyatakan dalam
Jadual ditetapkan sebagai entiti yang diberi kuasa.

JADUAL
[Perenggan 2]

1. Persatuan bagi Orang-Orang Buta Malaysia
2. Perpustakaan Negara Malaysia

Dibuat 15 Jun 2022
[KPDNKK.100-1/4/17; PN(PU2)457/V]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI
Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Hal Ehwal Pengguna

COPYRIGHT ACT 1987

COPYRIGHT (AUTHORIZED ENTITY) ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 13 (2C) of the Copyright Act 1987
[Act 332], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Copyright (Authorized Entity)
Order 2022.

 (2)  This Order comes into operation on 30 June 2022.

Non-profit making body or institution
2. The non-profit making body or institution specified in the Schedule is prescribed
as an authorized entity.

SCHEDULE
[Paragraph 2]

1. Malaysian Association for the Blind
2. National Library of Malaysia

Made 15 June 2022
[KPDNKK.100-1/4/17; PN(PU2)457/V]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI
Minister of Domestic Trade and Consumer Affairs
